hints.content:
The double number lines show that Jacob and his friends can make $\blueE{12}$ snowballs in $\maroonD1$ minute.


Time (minutes)| Number of snowballs
:-: | :-:
$1$ | $12$

The remaining values in the table represent ratios that are equivalent to this ratio.

To make $4$ times as many snowballs, will take $4$ times as many minutes.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A double number line with 3 unequally spaced tick marks. The values in the second number line, labeled Snowballs, are 12 times the corresponding values in the first number line, labeled Time (minutes). The line labeled Time (minutes), reads from left to right: 0, 1, 4. The line labeled Snowballs, reads from left to right: 0, 12, 48. An arrow from the pair 1 to 12 to the pair 4 to 48 is labeled times 4.

hints.content:
Taking $5$ times as many minutes, will result in $5$ times as many snowballs.


[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A double number line with 4 unequally spaced tick marks. The values in the second number line, labeled Snowballs, are 12 times the corresponding values in the first number line, labeled Time (minutes). The line labeled Time (minutes), reads from left to right: 0, 1, 4, 5. The line labeled Snowballs, reads from left to right: 0, 12, 48, 60. An arrow from the pair 1 to 12 to the pair 5 to 60 is labeled times 5.
